channel.title: Loosy Tale Studio blog
channel.description: Devlogs and notes from Loosy Tale Studio.

item.title: Now filming: Badge & Blood
item.description: Badge & Blood is our bodycam shooter in development: a 120° chest camera, glass that breaks pane by pane, drivable cars and one-on-one duels over LAN.

item.title: Five-Picture Deal: every stunt for real
item.description: You signed a five-picture deal, the director wants every stunt for real, and there is no stunt double. How our MegaJam stunt shooter plays.

item.title: HYPERDASH: a delivery made of microgames
item.description: SlapJam #2’s theme was SPEED. HYPERDASH answers with a ship that breaks every few seconds and 14 microgames to fix it, faster each time.

item.title: Rewind: the tape sees what you missed
item.description: Junction 4 went silent. Your bodycam replays the last 10 seconds, and the Lineman only exists on tape. How Rewind works.

item.title: The Weight of the Crown: one petitioner a day
item.description: King Edwin is dead and you killed him. Play Gregor the usurper, answer one petitioner a day, and keep nine pillars of power standing for 365 days.
